info: MASTER REFERENCE EXPANDED - File 04 - Travel & Tourism

words.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái
Qǐng bāng wǒ pāi zhāng zhào

words.en: Do I need to go through customs?
Can you recommend a day trip?
words.zh: 你能推荐一个一日游吗？
words.pinyin: Nǐ néng tuījiàn yīgè yīrìyóu ma?
Qǐng zài wǒ de hùzhào shàng gàizhāng

words.en: My gate changed at the last minute
words.pinyin: Wǒ de dēngjīkǒu línshí biàn le

words.en: Could you suggest a less crowded attraction?
words.zh: 你能推荐一个不那么拥挤的景点吗？
words.pinyin: Nǐ néng tuījiàn yīgè bù nàme yōngjǐ de jǐngdiǎn ma?

words.en: I'm waiting for the next boarding group
words.pinyin: Wǒ zài děng xià yī zǔ dēngjī

words.en: Can I store my bags before check-in opens?
words.zh: 办理入住前我可以寄存行李吗？
words.pinyin: Bànlǐ rùzhù qián wǒ kěyǐ jìcún xíngli ma?

words.en: We plan to explore the city on our own today
words.zh: 我们今天计划自己探索这座城市。
words.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān jìhuà zìjǐ tànsuǒ zhè zuò chéngshì
Wǒ kěyǐ kàn xià fángjiān ma?
Yǒu piányi diǎn de fángjiān ma?

words.en: Can I store my luggage here?
words.zh: 我可以把行李存在这里吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ bǎ xíngli cún zài zhèlǐ ma?

words.en: I would like a room upgrade

words.zh: 可以多给我几条毯子吗？
words.pinyin: Kěyǐ duō gěi wǒ jǐ tiáo tǎnzi ma?

words.zh: 客房清洁可以晚点来吗？
words.pinyin: Kèfáng qīngjié kěyǐ wǎndiǎn lái ma?

words.en: Could you hold my room? I'm arriving late tonight?
words.zh: 可以帮我保留房间吗？我今晚晚点到。
words.pinyin: Kěyǐ bāng wǒ bǎoliú fángjiān ma? Wǒ jīnwǎn wǎndiǎn dào

words.en: Is there a quieter floor available?
words.pinyin: Yǒu gèng ānjìng de lóucéng ma?

words.en: Could you confirm the total with all taxes?
Can you send someone to check the shower?
words.pinyin: Néng pài rén lái kànkan línyù ma?

words.en: I'd like to extend my stay by one more night
Please show me on the map
words.pinyin: Qǐng zài dìtú shàng zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn

words.en: Where do I buy a ticket?
Does this shuttle go to the airport?
words.pinyin: Zhè liàng bānchē qù jīchǎng ma?

words.en: Can I use a bus pass here?
Show me the landmark on the map
words.pinyin: Qǐng zài dìtú shàng zhǐchū dìbiāo
Yǒu gèng kuài de lùxiàn ma?

words.en: Should I transfer at the central station?
words.zh: 我应该在中央车站换乘吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ yīnggāi zài Zhōngyāng Chēzhàn huànchéng ma?

words.en: How long does it take by taxi during rush hour?
words.zh: 高峰期坐出租车要多久？

words.en: Could you drop me near the corner bakery?
words.zh: 能在街角面包店附近放我下来吗？
words.pinyin: Néng zài jiējiǎo miànbāodiàn fùjìn fàng wǒ xiàlai ma?

words.en: Is this lane reserved for buses only?
words.zh: 这条车道是公交专用的吗？
words.pinyin: Zhè tiáo chēdào shì gōngjiāo zhuānyòng de ma?

words.en: Text me when you're close to the landmark
words.zh: 快到地标时发短信给我。
words.pinyin: Kuài dào dìbiāo shí fā duǎnxìn gěi wǒ

words.en: I'd like a ticket to downtown
words.zh: 我想要一张去市中心的票。
words.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngyào yī zhāng qù shìzhōngxīn de piào

words.en: Is this a one-way or round-trip fare?
words.zh: 这是单程票价还是往返票价？
words.pinyin: Zhè shì dānchéng piàojià háishì wǎngfǎn piàojià?

words.en: What time does the next train leave?
words.pinyin: Xià yī bān huǒchē jǐ diǎn kāi?

words.en: Which platform should I go to?
Do I need a seat reservation?
Can I pay with a card?
words.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ yòng kǎ zhīfù ma?

words.en: Does this pass include the airport shuttle?
words.zh: 这张通票包含机场班车吗？
words.pinyin: Zhè zhāng tōngpiào bāohán jīchǎng bānchē ma?

words.en: Where can I validate my ticket?
Is the sleeper cabin available tonight?
How long is the night bus ride?
Can I store my luggage in a locker?
words.zh: 我可以把行李存在寄存柜里吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ bǎ xíngli cún zài jìcún guì lǐ ma?

words.en: My platform changed. Where do I go now?
words.zh: 我的站台变了。我现在去哪里？
words.pinyin: Wǒ de zhàntái biàn le. Wǒ xiànzài qù nǎlǐ?

words.en: Do I tap my card before boarding?
Could you print the ticket for me?
words.pinyin: Kěyǐ bāng wǒ dǎyìn chēpiào ma?

words.en: Where is the rideshare pickup zone?
Does the shuttle stop at this hotel?
words.pinyin: Bānchē zài zhè jiā jiǔdiàn tíng ma?

words.en: How much is the bicycle rental per hour?
words.zh: 自行车租赁每小时多少钱？
words.pinyin: Zìxíngchē zūlìn měi xiǎoshí duōshǎo qián?

words.en: Is fuel included with the car hire?
Can I get a travel voucher?
words.zh: 我可以拿旅游代金券吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ ná lǚyóu dàijīnquàn ma?

words.en: Who do I contact for insurance?
words.pinyin: Wǒ gāi liánxì shéi bào bǎoxiǎn?

words.en: I need a doctor who speaks English
words.zh: 我需要一位会说英语的医生。
words.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào yī wèi huì shuō Yīngyǔ de yīshēng

words.en: Where can I buy medicine nearby?
Is there a travel advisory today?
Do I need to fill out a health declaration?
words.zh: 我需要填写健康申报吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào tiánxiě jiànkāng shēnbào ma?

words.en: How do I report delayed luggage?
words.zh: 我该如何报告行李延误？
words.pinyin: Wǒ gāi rúhé bàogào xíngli yánwù?

words.en: Can someone translate this for me?
words.zh: 有人能帮我翻译这个吗？
words.pinyin: Yǒurén néng bāng wǒ fānyì zhège ma?

words.en: My bag is missing. Is there a lost property desk?
words.zh: 我的包不见了。有失物招领处吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ de bāo bùjiàn le. Yǒu shīwù zhāolǐng chù ma?

words.en: I need an embassy appointment as soon as possible
words.zh: 我需要尽快预约大使馆。

words.en: Can I file a complaint form online?
words.zh: 我可以在线提交投诉表吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ zàixiàn tíjiāo tóusù biǎo ma?

words.en: Is a refund possible in this situation?
words.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng kěyǐ tuìkuǎn ma?

words.en: Please call the emergency contact on my card
words.zh: 请拨打我卡上的紧急联系人电话。
words.pinyin: Qǐng bōdǎ wǒ kǎ shàng de jǐnjí liánxìrén diànhuà

words.en: Do you accept a backup card for payment?
words.zh: 你们接受备用卡付款吗？
words.pinyin: Nǐmen jiēshòu bèiyòng kǎ fùkuǎn ma?

words.en: Who can help me contact customer support?
words.pinyin: Shéi néng bāng wǒ liánxì kèfú?
